zh-Hans.text:
刘备死后, 孔明和赵云等人
完成刘备的约定
多次攻打魏军,
却始终未能取胜。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
劉備死後, 孔明和趙雲等人
完成劉備的約定
多次攻打魏軍,
卻始終未能取勝。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Four-line continuation of the E002 ending-question branch; preserves three LF bytes and uses ASCII comma to avoid an unreviewed punctuation slot. 等 and 卻 use the E-specific bounded custom map; known-screen evidence supports the ending branch, but natural E formatter/cache/VRAM receipt and final wording review remain pending.

zh-Hans.text:
不久, 过度出兵使
蜀的国力开始衰退,
孔明死后, 后主终被迫
向魏投降。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
不久, 過度出兵使
蜀的國力開始衰退,
孔明死後, 後主終被迫
向魏投降。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Four-line continuation in the same historical-ending branch; preserves three LF bytes and uses 後主 as the Taiwan historical title for Liu Chan in this compact line layout. 國 uses the E-specific bounded custom map; natural ending-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.
